6261.title: Repeated host discovery work
6261.rootCauseOneLine: The local API invokes application enumeration and icon extraction for every request without retaining a result or an in-flight promise.
6261.proposedFix: Use a bounded short-lived per-server promise cache keyed by file path and executable PATH, with failed-entry eviction.
6261.caveats: Real HTTP and macOS enumeration code exercised on Linux with the OS-command boundary substituted; native timing, process-launch measurements and pressure effects not verified.
